exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'z yoki iborani tanlang. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  famous
   2  tip
   3  food pills
   4  aluminium cans
   5  went
   6  crowded
   7  handmade
   8  kiss
   9  light
  10  traditional


HAR BIRI QAYSI BETDAN:

  1, 6, 7, 10 — Unit 13 (sayohat)
  2, 8       — Unit 14 (odob qoidalari)
  3          — Unit 13 (kelajak)
  4, 9       — Unit 14 (atrof-muhit)
  5          — Unit 13 (sayohat fe'llari)


⚠ ENG NOZIK BANDLAR:

  5  'I WENT on a boat trip.'
     ⚠ 'go ON a trip' — turg'un ibora.
     'ride' faqat ot, tuya, velosipedda
     ('ride a camel' — 104-bet).
     Qayiqda 'ride' ishlatilmaydi.

 10  'a TRADITIONAL restaurant'
     ⚠ 'delicious' faqat OVQAT haqida!
        'delicious food'       ✓
        'a delicious restaurant' ✗
     Restoran an'anaviy bo'lishi mumkin,
     mazali emas.

  9  'You mustn't LIGHT fires.'
     ⚠ 'to light a fire' = olov YOQMOQ
        'to burn' = yonmoq / kuydirmoq
     Olovni 'yoqish' — light.


ZID SO'ZLAR JUFTLARI:
  famous ↔ public
  tip ↔ gift
  pleasant ↔ crowded
  handmade ↔ clean
  light ↔ burn
  traditional ↔ delicious


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  famous     = mashhur
  a temple   = ibodatxona
  to tip     = choy pul bermoq
  a bellboy  = mehmonxona xizmatchisi
  a food pill = ovqat tabletkasi
  an oxygen mask = kislorod niqobi
  pre-packaged = oldindan qadoqlangan
  an aluminium can = alyuminiy banka
  a factory  = zavod
  crowded    = gavjum
  handmade   = qo'lda ishlangan
  a souvenir = sovg'a, esdalik
  to light a fire = olov yoqmoq
  traditional = an'anaviy

tasks.prompt: 1  Yesterday we visited a famous/public temple.
tasks.whyUz:
'a FAMOUS temple' = mashhur ibodatxona.

'public temple' tabiiy emas — ibodatxona
allaqachon ochiq joy.

'public' — 'public transport', 'in public'
kabi iboralarda ishlatiladi.

tasks.prompt: 2  You should always tip/gift bellboys in the USA.
tasks.promptUz: AQShda mehmonxona xizmatchilariga doim choy pul berish kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
'to TIP somebody' = choy pul bermoq (FE'L).

'gift' — OT (sovg'a), fe'l sifatida bu
ma'noda ishlatilmaydi.

Unit 14 (98-bet): AQShda choy pul berish odat.

tasks.prompt: 3  In the year 2050 there will be food pills/oxygen masks instead of fresh food.
tasks.promptUz: 2050-yilda yangi ovqat o'rniga ovqat tabletkalari bo'ladi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'instead of FRESH FOOD' — ovqat
o'rniga.

Ovqat o'rniga OVQAT TABLETKASI keladi,
kislorod niqobi emas.

Unit 13 — kelajak haqidagi bashoratlar.

tasks.prompt: 4  A lot of factories today use old pre-packaged food/aluminium cans to make new things.
tasks.promptUz: Bugun ko'p zavodlar yangi buyumlar yasash uchun eski alyuminiy bankalardan foydalanadi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'to make NEW THINGS' — qayta ishlash.

ESKI BANKALARDAN yangi buyum yasaladi.
Eski OVQATDAN yangi buyum yasalmaydi!

Unit 14 (99-bet) — qayta ishlash (recycling).

tasks.prompt: 5  When I was in London I went/rode on a boat trip.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'go ON a trip' — TURG'UN IBORA.
  'went on a boat trip'  ✓
  'rode on a boat trip'  ✗

'ride' faqat ot, tuya, velosiped, mototsikl
uchun ('I rode a camel' — 104-bet).

tasks.prompt: 6  'Did you have a good time at the museum?'  'No, it was noisy and pleasant/crowded.'
tasks.promptUz: 'Muzeyda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingizmi?' 'Yo'q, shovqinli va gavjum edi.'
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob 'NO' bilan boshlanadi va
'NOISY' (shovqinli) — SALBIY.

'pleasant' (yoqimli) — IJOBIY, 'no' ga zid.
'crowded' (gavjum) — salbiy, mos keladi.

tasks.prompt: 7  We bought some handmade/clean souvenirs.
tasks.promptUz: Biz qo'lda ishlangan sovg'alar sotib oldik.
tasks.whyUz:
'HANDMADE souvenirs' = qo'lda ishlangan
esdaliklar — sayyohlar sotib oladigan narsa.

'clean souvenirs' — mantiqsiz (sovg'a toza
yoki iflos bo'lishi asosiy xususiyat emas).

tasks.prompt: 8  You shouldn't talk/kiss anyone in public in China.
tasks.promptUz: Xitoyda ommaviy joyda hech kimni o'pmaslik kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
Unit 14 (98-bet) — Xitoy odob qoidalari:
ommaviy joyda o'pish mumkin emas.

'talk' mantiqsiz — gaplashish hamma joyda
mumkin!

'in public' = ommaviy joyda.

tasks.prompt: 9  You mustn't light/burn fires in the forest.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'to LIGHT a fire' = olov YOQMOQ
  (turg'un birikma)

'to burn' = yonmoq; kuydirmoq
  'The house is BURNING.' (yonyapti)
  'He BURNED the papers.' (qog'ozlarni
   kuydirdi)

Olovni 'yoqish' uchun DOIM 'light'.
light → lit → lit (noto'g'ri fe'l).

tasks.prompt: 10  We had dinner at a traditional/delicious restaurant last night.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'DELICIOUS' faqat OVQAT haqida!
  'delicious food'         ✓
  'a delicious restaurant' ✗

Restoran AN'ANAVIY bo'lishi mumkin, lekin
'mazali' bo'lolmaydi — ovqat mazali bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words/phrases below to fill in the gaps. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'z va iboralardan bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta):
  ballet lessons, a wonderful time, tell jokes,
  headache, join a gym, drop, public transport,
  washing-up liquid


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  washing-up liquid
  2  headache
  3  join a gym
  4  a wonderful time
  5  tell jokes
  6  ballet lessons
  7  drop
  8  public transport


⚠ KITOB BAHOSIDAGI NOMUVOFIQLIK:
  Mashqda 8 ta bo'sh joy bor, lekin
  '(10 marks)' deb yozilgan.
  Bu — kitobning kichik xatosi, javoblarga
  ta'sir qilmaydi.


⚠ ENG NOZIK BANDLAR — 1 va 8:

  Ikkalasida ham 'use / travel by' bor,
  shuning uchun chalkashish oson:

  1  'We should USE LESS ......... to help
      protect THE ENVIRONMENT.'
     → WASHING-UP LIQUID
     Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun idish
     yuvish suyuqligini KAMROQ ishlatish
     kerak (Unit 14, 99-bet).

     ⚠ 'public transport' BU YERDA XATO —
     jamoat transportini KAMROQ emas,
     KO'PROQ ishlatish kerak!

  8  'My father usually TRAVELS BY .........'
     → PUBLIC TRANSPORT
     'travel BY public transport' — turg'un
     birikma.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 2  'I've got a terrible ......... I'll take
    an ASPIRIN.'
    KALIT: aspirin — bosh og'rig'i dorisi.
    → HEADACHE

 3  'I want to KEEP FIT. Why don't you
    ......... ?'
    KALIT: 'keep fit' = sport bilan
    shug'ullanmoq.
    → JOIN A GYM (Workbook 57-bet)

 4  'We HAD ......... in Portugal.'
    KALIT: 'have a wonderful time' — turg'un
    ibora.
    → A WONDERFUL TIME

 5  'It's not a good idea to ......... to
    people you don't know IN CHINA.'
    KALIT: Xitoy odob qoidasi (Unit 14).
    → TELL JOKES

 6  'Mary is taking ......... because she
    wants to become A BALLERINA.'
    KALIT: ballerina — balet raqqosasi.
    → BALLET LESSONS

 7  'Do not ......... RUBBISH in the street —
    use a RUBBISH BIN instead.'
    KALIT: axlat.
    → DROP ('drop rubbish' = axlat tashlamoq)


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU ...?':
  'Why don't you JOIN a gym?' — TAKLIF.
  Keyin ASOSIY shakl.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE LESSONS':
  'to take lessons' = darsga qatnamoq
  'to take ballet/piano/driving lessons'


DIQQAT — 'DROP':
  'to drop rubbish' = axlat tashlamoq
     (yerga tashlab ketmoq)
  'to drop something' = tushirib yubormoq


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  washing-up liquid = idish yuvish suyuqligi
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  to protect  = himoya qilmoq
  a headache  = bosh og'rig'i
  an aspirin  = aspirin
  to keep fit = sog'lom qolmoq
  to join a gym = sport zaliga yozilmoq
  a wonderful time = ajoyib vaqt
  to tell jokes = hazil aytmoq
  ballet lessons = balet darslari
  a ballerina = balet raqqosasi
  to drop rubbish = axlat tashlamoq
  a rubbish bin = axlat qutisi
  public transport = jamoat transporti

tasks.promptUz: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun kamroq idish yuvish suyuqligi ishlatishimiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND!

KALIT: 'use LESS' + 'protect the ENVIRONMENT'.

tasks.prompt: 2  I've got a terrible ....................... . I'll take an aspirin.

KALIT: ASPIRIN — bosh og'rig'i dorisi.

'a terrible headache' = qattiq bosh og'rig'i.
'I've got a headache' — turg'un ibora.
tasks.speak: 2  I've got a terrible ....................... . I'll take an aspirin.

tasks.prompt: 3  'I want to keep fit.'  'Why don't you ..................... ?'
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'KEEP FIT' = sport bilan
shug'ullanmoq (Workbook 57-bet).

'Why don't you ...?' — TAKLIF, keyin ASOSIY
shakl ('Why don't you JOIN').
tasks.speak: 3  'I want to keep fit.'  'Why don't you ..................... ?'

tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HAVE a ... time' — turg'un ibora.

'have a wonderful/good/great time'
= yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq

1-mashqning 6-bandida ham bor edi:
'Did you HAVE A GOOD TIME?'

tasks.prompt: 5  I don't think it's a good idea to ..................................... to people you don't know in China.
tasks.promptUz: Xitoyda tanimagan odamlarga hazil aytish yaxshi fikr emas deb o'ylayman.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'IN CHINA' — Unit 14 odob qoidalari
(98-bet).

'to TELL a joke' — 'say' emas!
  tell a joke / tell a story / tell the truth
  say something / say hello
tasks.speak: 5  I don't think it's a good idea to ..................................... to people you don't know in China.

tasks.prompt: 6  Mary is taking ........................................... because she wants to become a ballerina.
tasks.promptUz: Meri balet darslariga qatnayapti, chunki u ballerina bo'lmoqchi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: BALLERINA = balet raqqosasi.

'to TAKE lessons' = darsga qatnamoq
(take ballet / piano / driving lessons).
tasks.speak: 6  Mary is taking ........................................... because she wants to become a ballerina.

tasks.prompt: 7  Do not ............................. rubbish in the street — use a rubbish bin instead.
tasks.promptUz: Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang — buning o'rniga axlat qutisidan foydalaning.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: RUBBISH va RUBBISH BIN.

'to DROP rubbish' = axlat tashlamoq
(yerga tashlab ketmoq).

Unit 14, 99-bet — atrof-muhit qoidalari.

KALIT: 'travel BY ...' — transport vositasi
keladi.

'travel BY public transport' — artiklsiz
(by car, by bus, by train kabi).

Grammar 66-bet: 'by' + transport — artikl
qo'yilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prepositions below to fill in the gaps. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi predloglardan bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta predlog):
  with, to, at, on, for, in, from, into


⚠ MUHIM: 10 TA BO'Sh JOY, 8 TA PREDLOG!
  2 va 8-bandlarda IKKITADAN bo'sh joy bor.
  Demak 'ON' va 'FOR' IKKI MARTA
  ishlatiladi.

  Kitob '(8 marks)' deb yozgan, lekin
  bo'sh joylar 10 ta — kichik nomuvofiqlik.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  FOR
  2  TO ... AT
  3  IN
  4  WITH
  5  INTO
  6  FROM
  7  ON
  8  ON ... FOR


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  'You should never be late FOR
     appointments.'

 2  'My sister is flying TO Toronto AT 8
     o'clock.'

 3  'I live IN the city centre.'

 4  'Don't talk WITH your mouth full, Tom.'

 5  'You mustn't throw plastic bottles INTO
     the sea.'

 6  'They came back FROM their holidays a
     week ago.'

 7  'You will go ON a short journey this
     week.'

 8  'Alex and Jo are going ON holiday FOR a
     whole month.'


TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR — YODLASh KERAK:

  be late FOR      = ... ga kechikmoq
  fly TO           = ... ga uchmoq
  AT 8 o'clock     = soat 8 da
  live IN          = ... da yashamoq
  talk WITH your mouth full
                   = og'iz to'la gaplashmoq
  throw INTO       = ... ning ichiga tashlamoq
  come back FROM   = ... dan qaytmoq
  go ON a journey  = sayohatga chiqmoq
  go ON holiday    = ta'tilga chiqmoq
  FOR a month      = bir oy davomida


⚠ 'IN' va 'INTO' FARQI:

  IN   = ichida (JOY — harakat yo'q)
     'I live IN the city centre.'

  INTO = ichiga (HARAKAT — tashqaridan
         ichkariga)
     'Don't throw bottles INTO the sea.'

  Shuning uchun 5-bandda 'in' emas, 'INTO'!


⚠ 'FOR' NING IKKI MA'NOSI:

  1-band: 'be late FOR' — turg'un birikma
  8-band: 'FOR a whole month' — DAVOMIYLIK
     (Unit 15: for/since qoidasi)


⚠ 'ON' NING IKKI ISHLATILIShI:

  7-band: 'go ON a journey' (sayohat)
  8-band: 'go ON holiday' (ta'til — artiklsiz)

  DIQQAT: 'go on HOLIDAY' — artikl YO'Q,
  lekin 'go on A journey' — artikl BOR.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an appointment = uchrashuv (belgilangan)
  the city centre = shahar markazi
  a mouth     = og'iz
  a plastic bottle = plastik shisha
  to throw    = tashlamoq
  to come back = qaytmoq
  a journey   = sayohat
  a whole month = butun bir oy

tasks.prompt: 1  You should never be late ................. appointments.
tasks.whyUz:
'be late FOR something' — TURG'UN BIRIKMA.
  be late FOR school / work / an appointment

'late to' XATO.
tasks.speak: 1  You should never be late ................. appointments.

tasks.prompt: 2  My sister is flying .............. Toronto .............. 8 o'clock.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: birinchisi)

'fly TO a place' — yo'nalish predlogi 'to'.
  fly to / go to / travel to / drive to

DIQQAT: 'arrive IN a city' (arrive to XATO).
tasks.speak: 2  My sister is flying .............. Toronto .............. 8 o'clock.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: birinchisi)

tasks.prompt: 2  My sister is flying to Toronto .............. 8 o'clock.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: ikkinchisi)

SOAT bilan DOIM 'AT':
  AT 8 o'clock / AT noon / AT midnight

Solishtiring:
  AT + soat;  ON + kun;  IN + oy/yil
tasks.speak: 2  My sister is flying to Toronto .............. 8 o'clock.  (IKKI bo'sh joy: ikkinchisi)

tasks.prompt: 3  I live ................ the city centre.
tasks.whyUz:
'live IN a place' — joy predlogi.
  live IN London / IN the city centre

⚠ 'IN' — harakat YO'Q (5-banddagi 'into' bilan
solishtiring).

tasks.prompt: 4  'Don't talk ........................... your mouth full, Tom.'
tasks.whyUz:
'talk WITH your mouth full' — TURG'UN
IBORA (og'iz to'la gaplashmoq).

Unit 14 — dasturxon odobi.

Bu qurilma 'with + ot + sifat' deyiladi:
'with his hands in his pockets'.

tasks.prompt: 5  You mustn't throw plastic bottles ........................... the sea.
tasks.promptUz: Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlash mumkin emas.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'IN' va 'INTO' FARQI:
  IN = ichida (harakat YO'Q)

'I WENT ON a boat trip.'

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words below to fill in the gaps. Then, use the phrases to write sentences, as in the example. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlardan bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. So'ngra namunadagidek iboralar bilan gaplar tuzing. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta):
  chew, short, pre-packaged, find, huge, sore,
  earn, great

KITOB NAMUNASI:
  'John wants to FIND A BETTER JOB.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  to FIND a better job
  2  GREAT news
  3  to EARN money
  4  a SHORT trip
  5  PRE-PACKAGED food
  6  to CHEW gum
  7  a SORE throat
  8  HUGE temples


SO'ZLAR TURI BO'YIChA:

  FE'LLAR (oldida 'to' bor):
     1  find  (topmoq)
     3  earn  (topmoq — pul)
     6  chew  (chaynamoq)

  SIFATLAR (otdan oldin):
     2  great        (ajoyib)
     4  short        (qisqa)
     5  pre-packaged (qadoqlangan)
     7  sore         (og'riyotgan)
     8  huge         (ulkan)

  ⚠ QANDAY ANIQLANADI:
  1, 3, 6-bandlarda 'TO' bor → FE'L kerak.
  Qolganlarida ot bor → SIFAT kerak.


⚠ 'FIND' va 'EARN' FARQI:
  ikkalasi ham o'zbekchada 'topmoq':

  to FIND = topmoq (yo'qolgan/izlangan
     narsani)
     'find a job', 'find my keys'

  to EARN = ishlab topmoq (PUL)
     'earn money', 'earn a living'

  'find money' — yerdan pul topmoq!
  'earn money' — mehnat bilan topmoq.


GAP NAMUNALARI (har ibora bilan):

 1  'John wants to FIND A BETTER JOB.'
    (kitob namunasi)

 2  'I've got GREAT NEWS for you!'
    (Sizga ajoyib xabarim bor!)

 3  'He works hard to EARN MONEY.'
    (U pul topish uchun qattiq ishlaydi.)

 4  'We went on A SHORT TRIP to the
     mountains.'
    (Biz tog'larga qisqa sayohatga chiqdik.)

 5  'A lot of factories make PRE-PACKAGED
     FOOD.'
    (Ko'p zavodlar qadoqlangan ovqat
     ishlab chiqaradi.)

 6  'You mustn't CHEW GUM in class.'
    (Darsda saqich chaynash mumkin emas.)

 7  'I've got A SORE THROAT, so I can't
     sing.'
    (Tomog'im og'riyapti, shuning uchun
     kuylay olmayman.)

 8  'We visited HUGE TEMPLES in Thailand.'
    (Tailandda ulkan ibodatxonalarni
     ko'rdik.)


⚠ 'NEWS' — SANALMAYDIGAN:
  'GREAT NEWS' — artikl YO'Q!
     'great news'    ✓
     'a great news'  ✗

  Fe'l BIRLIKDA:
     'The news IS good.'  ✓
     'The news ARE good.' ✗


⚠ 'SORE' — FAQAT TANA A'ZOSI HAQIDA:
  a sore throat  = og'riyotgan tomoq
  sore eyes      = og'riyotgan ko'zlar
  sore feet      = og'riyotgan oyoqlar

  Umumiy 'og'riq' uchun: 'It HURTS.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to chew     = chaynamoq
  chewing gum = saqich
  short       = qisqa
  pre-packaged = oldindan qadoqlangan
  to find     = topmoq
  huge        = ulkan
  sore        = og'riyotgan
  a throat    = tomoq
  to earn     = ishlab topmoq
  great       = ajoyib
  news        = xabar (SANALMAYDIGAN)

tasks.prompt: 1  to ........... a better job   →   NAMUNA: John wants to find a better job.
tasks.whyUz:
KITOB NAMUNASI.

'TO' bor → FE'L kerak.

⚠ 'find' va 'earn' FARQI:
  find = topmoq (ish, kalit)
  earn = ishlab topmoq (PUL)
tasks.speak: 1  to ........... a better job   →   NAMUNA: John wants to find a better job.

tasks.whyUz:
'news' — OT, oldiga SIFAT kerak → GREAT.

⚠ 'news' SANALMAYDIGAN: artikl YO'Q!
  'great news'   ✓
  'a great news' ✗

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the table below with the past simple and past participles of the verbs. (7 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvalni fe'llarning Past Simple va Past Participle shakllari bilan to'ldiring. (7 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  Infinitive   Past Simple   Past Participle
  ──────────────────────────────────────────
   1  be        WAS / WERE    BEEN
   2  buy       BOUGHT        bought (berilgan)
   3  call      called (ber.) CALLED
   4  do        DID           DONE
   5  go        WENT          gone (berilgan)
   6  have      HAD           HAD
   7  live      LIVED         LIVED
   8  return    returned(ber) RETURNED
   9  see       SAW           SEEN
  10  spend     SPENT         spent (berilgan)
  11  stay      STAYED        STAYED
  12  take      took (ber.)   TAKEN
  13  visit     VISITED       VISITED
  14  want      WANTED        wanted (berilgan)


⚠ KITOB BAHOSIDAGI NOMUVOFIQLIK:
  Jadvalda 21 ta bo'sh katak bor, lekin
  '(7 marks)' deb yozilgan
  (ehtimol har 3 katak = 1 ball).


IKKI GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (-ED qo'shiladi) — 6 ta:
     call   → called  → called
     live   → lived   → lived
     return → returned → returned
     stay   → stayed  → stayed
     visit  → visited → visited
     want   → wanted  → wanted

     ⚠ Ikkala shakl BIR XIL!

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR — 8 ta:
     be   → was/were → been
     buy  → bought   → bought
     do   → did      → done
     go   → went     → gone
     have → had      → had
     see  → saw      → seen
     spend → spent   → spent
     take → took     → taken


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLARNI GURUHLASh:

  UCh SHAKL HAM BIR XIL: (yo'q bu jadvalda)

  2 va 3-ShAKL BIR XIL — 4 ta:
     buy   → BOUGHT → BOUGHT
     have  → HAD    → HAD
     spend → SPENT  → SPENT

  UCh SHAKL HAM BOShQA — 5 ta:
     be   → WAS/WERE → BEEN
     do   → DID      → DONE
     go   → WENT     → GONE
     see  → SAW      → SEEN
     take → TOOK     → TAKEN


⚠ 'BE' — IKKI SHAKLI BOR:
  I / he / she / it   → WAS
  you / we / they     → WERE
  Past Participle     → BEEN (bitta)


⚠ 'BEEN' va 'GONE' FARQI (Unit 15!):
  'He has GONE to Paris.'
     → Parijda, HALI QAYTMAGAN
  'He has BEEN to Paris.'
     → Parijga borib KELGAN (tajriba)

  Grammar 65-bet, Workbook 61-bet.


⚠ '-ED' NING YOZILISh QOIDALARI:
  live  → livED   ('e' bor → faqat 'd')
  stay  → stayED  (unli + y → to'g'ridan)
  visit → visitED
  want  → wantED

  Solishtiring:
     study → studIED (undosh + y → i + ed)
     stop  → stopPED (bitta undosh ikkilanadi)


QAYERDA IShLATILADI:
  Past Simple      → Past Simple zamonda
  Past Participle  → Present Perfect da
                     (have/has + V3)

  'I VISITED Paris last year.' (Past Simple)
  'I HAVE VISITED Paris.' (Present Perfect)

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  for      →  SINCE
   2  so       →  BECAUSE
   3  some     →  ANY
   4  There    →  IT
   5  have you visited → DID YOU VISIT
   6  must     →  MUSTN'T
   7  hasn't never travelled → HAS NEVER
                              TRAVELLED
   8  should   →  SHOULDN'T
   9  Has you sent → HAVE YOU SENT
  10  have gone →  WENT
  11  must     →  CAN
  12  cooks    →  IS COOKING


XATOLARNI TURLARGA BO'LISh:

  UNIT 15 (Present Perfect) — 1, 5, 7, 9, 10
  UNIT 14 (must/mustn't/should) — 6, 8, 11
  UNIT 13 (kelajak, some/any) — 2, 3, 4
  ZAMON tanlash — 12


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'Karen has lived here FOR 1989.'
    ⚠ 1989 — NUQTA (qachondan), DAVOMIYLIK
    emas.
       SINCE + boshlanish nuqtasi
          (since 1989, since Monday)
       FOR + davomiylik
          (for 3 years, for a month)
    → SINCE 1989

 2  '... in the holidays SO he wants to earn
     extra money.'
    ⚠ Pul topish — ishlashning SABABI, natijasi
    emas!
       [natija] BECAUSE [sabab]
    → BECAUSE
    (113-bet, 4-mashq — bir xil qoida)

 3  'There aren't SOME clouds in the sky.'
    ⚠ INKOR gapda 'any':
       tasdiq  → some
       inkor   → any
       savol   → any
    → ANY

 4  'THERE will be snowy in Montreal.'
    ⚠ Ob-havo haqida 'IT':
       'IT will be snowy/sunny/cold.'
       'THERE will be snow.' (ot bilan)
    'snowy' — SIFAT → 'it' kerak.
    → IT

 5  'When HAVE YOU VISITED the museum?'
    ⚠ 'WHEN' bilan Present Perfect
    IShLATILMAYDI!
    'when' aniq vaqt so'raydi → Past Simple.
    → DID YOU VISIT

 6  'You MUST smoke in hospitals.'
    ⚠ Mantiq: kasalxonada chekish TAQIQLANGAN!
       must    = shart
       mustn't = taqiqlangan
    → MUSTN'T

 7  'Sharon HASN'T NEVER TRAVELLED by plane.'
    ⚠ IKKI INKOR — ingliz tilida MUMKIN EMAS!
    'never' o'zi allaqachon inkor.
       'has NEVER travelled'  ✓
       'hasn't EVER travelled' ✓
       'hasn't never travelled' ✗
    → HAS NEVER TRAVELLED

 8  'You SHOULD use aerosols. They POLLUTE the
     air.'
    ⚠ Mantiq: aerozol havoni IFLOSLAYDI →
    ishlatMASLIK kerak.
    → SHOULDN'T

 9  'HAS YOU SENT the invitations yet?'
    ⚠ 'you' bilan DOIM 'have':
       I/you/we/they → HAVE
       he/she/it     → HAS
    → HAVE YOU SENT

10  'They HAVE GONE to the zoo YESTERDAY.'
    ⚠ 'yesterday' — ANIQ VAQT → Past Simple!
    Present Perfect da aniq vaqt BO'LMAYDI.
    → WENT

11  'Mum, MUST I have an ice-cream, please?'
    ⚠ Ruxsat SO'RASh uchun 'can', 'must' emas.
    'Must I ...?' = 'Majburmanmi?' — muzqaymoq
    yeyish majburiyat emas!
    'please' ham iltimosni ko'rsatadi.
    → CAN

12  'He COOKS dinner AT THE MOMENT.'
    ⚠ 'at the moment' — Present Continuous
    ko'rsatkichi!
    → IS COOKING


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN — 5-BAND:

  'WHEN' + Present Perfect — DOIMO XATO.

  Sababi: Present Perfect vaqtni AYTMAYDI,
  'when' esa aynan vaqtni SO'RAYDI.
  Ular bir-biriga zid!

     'WHEN DID you visit?'    ✓
     'HAVE you visited?'      ✓ (when yo'q)
     'When have you visited?' ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  extra money = qo'shimcha pul
  a cloud    = bulut
  snowy      = qorli
  to smoke   = chekmoq
  an aerosol = aerozol
  to pollute = ifloslantirmoq
  an invitation = taklifnoma
  a zoo      = hayvonot bog'i
  at the moment = hozir

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  for
  2  ago
  3  never
  4  yet ... just


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  'I haven't been windsurfing FOR a month.'
    (Bir oydan beri vindserfing qilmadim.)

 2  'We went on a boat trip two weeks AGO.'
    (Ikki hafta oldin qayiq sayohatiga
     chiqdik.)

 3  'Maria has NEVER played football.'
    (Mariya hech qachon futbol o'ynamagan.)

 4  A: 'Has Peter washed the car YET?'
    B: 'Yes, he has. He's JUST finished.'
    (A: Piter mashinani yuvdimi?
     B: Ha. U hozirgina tugatdi.)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  FOR ↔ SINCE:
       FOR + DAVOMIYLIK (qancha vaqt)
          for a month, for 3 years, for ages
       SINCE + NUQTA (qachondan)
          since 1989, since Monday, since May

    'a month' — davomiylik → FOR

 2  AGO ↔ LAST:
       AGO — o'lchov + 'ago', GAP OXIRIDA
          two weeks AGO, a year AGO
       LAST — otdan OLDIN
          LAST week, LAST year

    'two weeks ...' → AGO
    ('two weeks last' — mumkin emas)

    ⚠ 'ago' — DOIM Past Simple bilan!

 3  NEVER ↔ EVER:
       NEVER — inkor ma'no, TASDIQ shaklda
          'She has NEVER played.'
       EVER — faqat SAVOLDA
          'Have you EVER played?'

    Bu gap SAVOL emas → NEVER

 4  YET ↔ JUST:
       YET — SAVOL va INKORDA, gap OXIRIDA
          'Has he finished YET?'
          'He hasn't finished YET.'
       JUST — TASDIQDA, have/has bilan fe'l
          ORASIDA
          'He has JUST finished.'

    Birinchi gap SAVOL → YET
    Ikkinchi gap TASDIQ → JUST


⚠ 4-BAND — O'RIN JOYLAShUVI:

  YET — gap OXIRIDA:
     'Has Peter washed the car YET?'

  JUST — HAVE/HAS va V3 ORASIDA:
     'He HAS JUST FINISHED.'
     ('He has finished just' ✗)


UNIT 15 QOIDALARINING TAKRORI:
  for / since  — Grammar 66-bet
  ever / never — Grammar 66-bet
  just / yet / already — Grammar 65-bet


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  windsurfing = vindserfing
  a boat trip = qayiq sayohati
  to wash     = yuvmoq
  to finish   = tugatmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLAR:
  • Would you like to go?
  • What are you doing tonight?


JAVOBLAR:
  1  What are you doing tonight?
  2  Would you like to go?


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: 'Hello, Helen. WHAT ARE YOU DOING
      TONIGHT?'
  B: 'I haven't got any plans. Why?'
  A: 'Well, there's a great concert on at the
      Royal Palace tonight. WOULD YOU LIKE TO
      GO?'
  B: 'Yes — that would be great!'
  A: 'Okay. I'll pick you up at seven, then.'


TARJIMASI:
  A: 'Salom, Helen. Bugun kechqurun nima
      qilyapsan?'
  B: 'Hech qanday rejam yo'q. Nima edi?'
  A: 'Bugun kechqurun Royal Palace'da ajoyib
      konsert bor. Borishni xohlaysanmi?'
  B: 'Ha — zo'r bo'lardi!'
  A: 'Yaxshi. Unda soat yettida olib
      ketaman.'


MANTIQ — QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

 1  Javob: 'I haven't got any PLANS.'
    → Savol REJA haqida bo'lishi kerak.
    → 'What are you doing tonight?'

    ⚠ 'Would you like to go?' bu yerda XATO —
    hali qayerga borish aytilmagan!

 2  Oldin: 'there's a great CONCERT on'
    Keyin: 'Yes — that would be great!'
    → Savol TAKLIF bo'lishi kerak.
    → 'Would you like to go?'


⚠ 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING TONIGHT?' —
KELAJAK MA'NOSIDA:

  Present Continuous — REJALAShTIRILGAN
  kelajak uchun ham ishlatiladi.

     'What are you doing tonight?'
     = Bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsan?
       (rejang nima?)

  Unit 13 — kelajak shakllari.


⚠ 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO ...?' — MUShTARAK
TAKLIF ShAKLI:

  'Would you like to go?' = Borishni
  xohlaysanmi? (muloyim taklif)

  Javoblari:
     'Yes, I'd love to.'
     'That would be great!'
     'I'm afraid I can't.'

  Boshqa taklif shakllari:
     'How about going?'
     'Why don't we go?'
     'Let's go!'


DIQQAT — 'THERE'S A CONCERT ON':
  'there's ... ON' = ... bo'lyapti,
  o'tkazilyapti

  'What's on tonight?' = Bugun nima bor?


DIQQAT — 'PICK SOMEBODY UP':
  'I'll PICK YOU UP at seven.'
  = seni soat yettida olib ketaman
  (mashinada borib olmoq)

  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     pick you up   ✓
     pick up you   ✗


DIQQAT — 'I'LL':
  'I'LL pick you up' — o'sha zahoti qabul
  qilingan qaror → WILL (Unit 13).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  plans        = rejalar
  a concert    = konsert
  there's ... on = ... bo'lyapti
  Would you like to ...? = ... ni
                 xohlaysizmi?
  That would be great! = Zo'r bo'lardi!
  to pick somebody up = borib olmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta):
  can, can't, should, mustn't


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  should
  2  can
  3  can
  4  can't
  5  mustn't


⚠ 5 TA BO'Sh JOY, 4 TA FE'L!
  'CAN' IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi (2 va 3).

  Kitob '(4 marks)' deb yozgan — bu
  og'irlikli baholash, xato emas.


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  1-dialog:
     A: 'I have got the flu.'
     B: 'You SHOULD see a doctor.'

     (A: Grippim bor.
      B: Shifokorga ko'rinishing kerak.)

  2-dialog:
     A: 'Mum, CAN I have a glass of milk,
         please?'
     B: 'Yes, of course you CAN.'

     (A: Oyi, bir stakan sut ichsam
         bo'ladimi?
      B: Ha, albatta, bo'ladi.)

  3-dialog:
     A: 'Can I feed the animals?'
     B: 'No, you CAN'T. You MUSTN'T feed the
         animals — it's forbidden.'

     (A: Hayvonlarni boqsam bo'ladimi?
      B: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Hayvonlarni
         boqmaslik kerak — bu taqiqlangan.)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'I have got THE FLU.' → kasal.
    Kasal odamga MASLAHAT → SHOULD.
    'You should see a doctor.'

    ⚠ 'must' emas — bu do'stona maslahat,
    qonun emas.

 2  'Mum, ......... I have ..., PLEASE?'
    RUXSAT SO'RASh → CAN.
    'please' — iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

    (114-bet, 6-mashq, 11-band: 'Must I have
     an ice-cream?' XATO edi — aynan shu
     qoida!)

 3  'Yes, of course you .........'
    RUXSAT BERISh → CAN.
    Savoldagi fe'l takrorlanadi.

 4  'No, you .........'
    RUXSAT BERMASLIK → CAN'T.
    Savol 'Can I ...?' edi → javob 'you
    CAN'T'.

 5  'You ......... feed the animals — IT'S
     FORBIDDEN.'
    KALIT: 'FORBIDDEN' (taqiqlangan)
    → MUSTN'T (qat'iy taqiq).


⚠ 4 va 5-BANDLAR FARQI:

  CAN'T — 'ruxsat yo'q' (javob)
  MUSTN'T — 'TAQIQLANGAN' (qoida, qonun)

  Ikkalasi ham inkor, lekin MUSTN'T
  KUCHLIROQ.

  Shuning uchun kitob avval 'can't', keyin
  sababini 'mustn't' bilan aytadi.


TO'RT FE'LNING UMUMIY JADVALI:

  CAN     = mumkin (ruxsat, qobiliyat)
  CAN'T   = mumkin emas
  SHOULD  = kerak (MASLAHAT)
  MUSTN'T = TAQIQLANGAN (qat'iy)

  ⚠ Hammasidan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'you should SEE'  ✓
     'you should TO see' ✗

ANNNING SEM'GA YOZGAN XATI (Londondan).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  is
   2  am having
   3  am staying
   4  lives
   5  have already visited
   6  visited
   7  bought
   8  have also been

  12  went

TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  'Dear Sam,
   Greetings from London! The weather IS warm
   and sunny and I AM HAVING a wonderful
   time. I AM STAYING with my Uncle Douglas.
   He LIVES in the city centre.

   I HAVE ALREADY VISITED Buckingham Palace.
   We VISITED it on Friday. I BOUGHT some
   postcards there. I HAVE ALSO BEEN to
   Harrods. My uncle TOOK me there yesterday,
   but I DIDN'T BUY anything. I HAVE EATEN at
   an Indian restaurant too! We WENT there
   last night and I HAD a very hot curry!

   There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T DONE
   yet. I HAVEN'T BEEN to Covent Garden or
   Piccadilly Circus yet. We ARE GOING to
   Hyde Park tomorrow.

   London is a fascinating city — you must
   visit it one day! Anyway, I AM RETURNING
   home on 15th June, so I WILL CALL you
   then.
   Best wishes,
   Ann'


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA:

  PRESENT SIMPLE — 1, 4
     doimiy holat / hozirgi holat

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 2, 3, 16, 17
     vaqtinchalik holat va
     rejalashtirilgan kelajak

  PRESENT PERFECT — 5, 8, 11, 14, 15
     vaqt AYTILMAGAN; already/yet bilan

  PAST SIMPLE — 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13
     ANIQ VAQT bor (on Friday, yesterday,
     last night)

  WILL — 18
     va'da


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAMUNA — PRESENT PERFECT keyin
PAST SIMPLE:

  Ann avval NATIJANI aytadi (vaqtsiz),
  keyin TAFSILOTNI (vaqt bilan):

     'I HAVE ALREADY VISITED Buckingham
      Palace.'  (vaqt yo'q → Present Perfect)
     'We VISITED it ON FRIDAY.'
        (aniq vaqt → Past Simple)

     'I HAVE ALSO BEEN to Harrods.'
        (vaqt yo'q)
     'My uncle TOOK me there YESTERDAY.'
        (aniq vaqt)

     'I HAVE EATEN at an Indian restaurant.'
        (vaqt yo'q)
     'We WENT there LAST NIGHT.'
        (aniq vaqt)

  Bu — Unit 15 ning ASOSIY namunasi!


⚠ 8 va 15-BANDLAR — 'BEEN' yoki 'GONE'?

  Qavsda 'go' berilgan, lekin to'g'ri javob
  'BEEN':

     'I have BEEN to Harrods.'
     = borib KELDIM (hozir u yerda emasman)

     'I have GONE to Harrods.'
     = ketdim, HALI U YERDAMAN

  Ann amakisining uyidan xat yozyapti,
  demak Harrods'dan QAYTGAN → BEEN.

  15-band ham shunday:
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN to Covent Garden yet.'
     = hali bormadim

  Grammar 65-bet, Workbook 61-bet — been/gone
  qoidasi.


⚠ 3-BAND va 4-BAND FARQI:

  'I AM STAYING with my uncle.'
     → VAQTINCHALIK (Present Continuous)

  'He LIVES in the city centre.'
     → DOIMIY (Present Simple)

  Ann bir necha kunga kelgan — vaqtinchalik.
  Amakisi doim u yerda yashaydi.


⚠ 16 va 17-BANDLAR — KELAJAK:

  'We ARE GOING to Hyde Park TOMORROW.'
  'I AM RETURNING home ON 15TH JUNE.'

  Present Continuous — REJALAShTIRILGAN,
  ANIQ vaqt belgilangan kelajak (Unit 13).

  ⚠ 18-band boshqacha:
     'I WILL CALL you then.'
     → VA'DA (o'sha zahoti qabul qilingan
       qaror) → WILL


⚠ 14-BAND — 'YET':
  'a lot of things I HAVEN'T DONE YET'
  'yet' — INKORDA, gap oxirida
  → Present Perfect

  do → did → DONE


DIQQAT — 'GREETINGS FROM ...':
  'Greetings from London!' = Londondan salom!
  Otkritka va xatlarda turg'un ibora.


DIQQAT — 'A HOT CURRY':
  'hot' bu yerda = AChChIQ (issiq emas!)
  'a very hot curry' = juda achchiq karri


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  greetings   = salomlar
  to stay with = ... nikida turmoq
  a postcard  = otkritka
  Harrods     = Londondagi mashhur do'kon
  curry       = karri (hind taomi)
  hot         = achchiq (taom haqida)
  Covent Garden / Piccadilly Circus / Hyde Park
              = Londondagi mashhur joylar
  fascinating = maftunkor
  Anyway      = xullas
  to return   = qaytmoq

YETTI GAPNING HAMMASI NOTO'G'RI —
HAMMASINI TUZATISh KERAK.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  ✗ 'The weather in London is RAINY.'
    ✓ 'The weather in London is WARM AND
       SUNNY.'
    Dalil: 'The weather is WARM AND SUNNY.'

 2  ✗ 'Ann is having a TERRIBLE time.'
    ✓ 'Ann is having a WONDERFUL time.'
    Dalil: 'I am having A WONDERFUL TIME.'

 3  ✗ 'Ann HASN'T VISITED Buckingham Palace
       YET.'
    ✓ 'Ann HAS ALREADY VISITED Buckingham
       Palace. She visited it ON FRIDAY.'
    Dalil: 'I have ALREADY visited Buckingham
    Palace. We visited it on Friday.'

 4  ✗ 'Ann BOUGHT LOTS OF THINGS in Harrods.'
    ✓ 'Ann DIDN'T BUY ANYTHING in Harrods.'
    Dalil: 'but I didn't buy anything.'

 5  ✗ 'Ann's uncle took her to A TRADITIONAL
       RESTAURANT.'
    ✓ 'Ann's uncle took her to HARRODS. She
       went to AN INDIAN RESTAURANT with
       somebody else ("we"), not with her
       uncle.'
    Dalil: 'My uncle took me THERE
    [= to Harrods] yesterday.'

 6  ✗ 'Ann and her uncle are going to COVENT
       GARDEN tomorrow.'
    ✓ 'Ann and her uncle are going to HYDE
       PARK tomorrow. She hasn't been to
       Covent Garden YET.'
    Dalil: 'We are going to HYDE PARK
    tomorrow.'

 7  ✗ 'Ann is returning home on 20TH AUGUST.'
    ✓ 'Ann is returning home on 15TH JUNE.'
    Dalil: 'I am returning home on 15TH
    JUNE.'


⚠ 3-BAND — ENG NOZIK:

  Gap 'HASN'T ... YET' deydi, lekin xatda
  'ALREADY' bor — bu ikkalasi ZID!

     'hasn't ... YET' = hali qilmagan
     'has ALREADY ...' = allaqachon qilgan

  Tuzatishda 'yet' ni 'already' ga
  almashtirish kerak.


⚠ 5-BAND — ENG PUXTA O'QISh KERAK:

  Xatda IKKI JOY bor:
     a) Harrods — AMAKISI olib borgan
        ('MY UNCLE took me THERE')
     b) Hind restorani — 'WE went there'
        (amakisi aytilmagan)

  Gap ikkalasini ChALKAShTIRGAN.

  To'g'ri tuzatish: amakisi uni HARRODS'ga
  olib borgan, restoranga emas.


⚠ 6-BAND — IKKI XATO:

  a) Joyi noto'g'ri: Covent Garden emas,
     HYDE PARK.
  b) Xatda aniq aytilgan: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN to
     Covent Garden YET.'


TUZATISh USULI — QOLIP:

  'No, ... isn't/doesn't ... . ... is/does
   ... .'

  Masalan:
     'No, the weather isn't rainy. It's warm
      and sunny.'
     'No, Ann didn't buy lots of things. She
      didn't buy anything.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  rainy       = yomg'irli
  terrible    = dahshatli
  lots of     = ko'p
  to correct  = to'g'rilamoq
  a statement = bayonot, gap

DALIL: 'The weather IS WARM AND SUNNY.'
(xatning birinchi gapi)

tasks.uz: 2 ✗ Ann dahshatli vaqt o'tkazyapti. → ✓ Ann ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapti.

DALIL: 'I am having A WONDERFUL TIME.'

terrible (dahshatli) ↔ wonderful (ajoyib).

tasks.en: 3  ✗ Ann hasn't visited Buckingham Palace yet.  →  ✓ Ann has already visited Buckingham Palace. She visited it on Friday.
tasks.uz: 3 ✗ Ann hali Bukingem saroyiga bormagan. → ✓ Ann allaqachon borgan. U juma kuni borgan.

⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND!

DALIL: 'I have ALREADY visited Buckingham
Palace. We visited it ON FRIDAY.'

'hasn't ... YET' va 'has ALREADY ...' — ZID.
Tuzatishda 'yet' ni 'already' ga almashtiring.

tasks.uz: 4 ✗ Ann Harrods'da ko'p narsa sotib oldi. → ✓ Ann Harrods'da hech narsa sotib olmadi.

'anything' — inkorda ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: 5  ✗ Ann's uncle took her to a traditional restaurant.  →  ✓ Ann's uncle took her to Harrods. She went to an Indian restaurant, but not with her uncle.
tasks.uz: 5 ✗ Ann amakisi uni an'anaviy restoranga olib bordi. → ✓ Amakisi uni Harrods'ga olib bordi. Hind restoraniga esa boshqalar bilan bordi.
tasks.note:
⚠ ENG PUXTA O'QISH KERAK!

DALIL: 'My uncle took me THERE [= to
HARRODS] yesterday.'
Restoran haqida esa: 'WE went there last
night' — amakisi aytilmagan.

Gap ikki joyni CHALKASHTIRGAN.

tasks.en: 6  ✗ Ann and her uncle are going to Covent Garden tomorrow.  →  ✓ Ann and her uncle are going to Hyde Park tomorrow. She hasn't been to Covent Garden yet.
tasks.uz: 6 ✗ Ann va amakisi ertaga Kovent Gardenga borishadi. → ✓ Ular ertaga Hayd Parkka borishadi. Ann hali Kovent Gardenga bormagan.
tasks.note:
⚠ IKKI XATO:
a) DALIL: 'We are going to HYDE PARK
   tomorrow.'
b) DALIL: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN to Covent Garden
   or Piccadilly Circus YET.'

tasks.en: 7  ✗ Ann is returning home on 20th August.  →  ✓ Ann is returning home on 15th June.
tasks.uz: 7 ✗ Ann 20-avgustda uyga qaytadi. → ✓ Ann 15-iyunda uyga qaytadi.

DALIL: 'I am returning home on 15TH JUNE.'

Xatning boshida sana yo'q, lekin oxirida
aniq aytilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts below to complete Helen's letter to her friend, Pam. (15 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ishoralardan foydalanib, Helenning dugonasi Pamga yozgan xatini to'ldiring. (15 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT SARLAVHASI (kitobda berilgan):
  14, Scott Road
  Romley
  8th June, ...

  Dear Pam,
  ...
  Love,
  Helen


TO'LIQ XAT — TO'G'RI JAVOB:

──────────────────────────────────────────
  14, Scott Road
  Romley
  8th June, ...

  Dear Pam,

  Guess what! I AM GOING on holiday with my
  friend Claire for a whole month!

  We ARE FLYING to Spain on 20th June.
  Claire and I LOVE climbing, so we ARE
  STAYING at a hotel near the Pyrenees. We
  WANT to travel around Spain too, so we ARE
  HIRING a car.

  We ARE COMING BACK from our holidays on
  21st July and I HAVE GOT lots of plans for
  the autumn. First, I AM GOING TO START
  exercising because I WANT TO LOSE some
  weight. I AM GOING TO JOIN an art class and
  LEARN HOW TO PAINT, too.

  Oh! I NEARLY FORGOT! On 30th July I AM
  HAVING a party at my house. Please TRY TO
  COME. You CAN SPEND the night here.

  Well, THAT IS all for now. HOPE TO SEE you
  soon.

  Love,
  Helen
──────────────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  Aziz Pam,

  Bilasanmi nima! Men dugonam Kler bilan
  butun bir oyga ta'tilga chiqyapman!

  20-iyunda Ispaniyaga uchamiz. Kler bilan
  ikkalamiz tog'ga chiqishni yaxshi ko'ramiz,
  shuning uchun Pireney tog'lari yaqinidagi
  mehmonxonada turamiz. Ispaniya bo'ylab ham
  sayohat qilmoqchimiz, shuning uchun mashina
  ijaraga olamiz.

  21-iyulda ta'tildan qaytamiz va kuz uchun
  ko'p rejalarim bor. Avvalo, sport bilan
  shug'ullana boshlayman, chunki biroz vazn
  tashlamoqchiman. Rassomchilik to'garagiga
  ham yoziladigan va rasm chizishni
  o'rganaman.

  Voy! Deyarli unutayozdim! 30-iyulda uyimda
  bazm o'tkazaman. Iltimos, kelishga harakat
  qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang bo'ladi.

  Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishamiz
  degan umiddaman.

  Mehr bilan,
  Helen


HAR PARAGRAF UChUN QAYSI ZAMON:

 1-PARAGRAF — YANGILIK e'lon qilish:
    'I AM GOING on holiday'
    → Present Continuous (rejalashtirilgan
      kelajak, sana belgilangan)

 2-PARAGRAF — ANIQ REJALAR (sanalar bor):
    'We ARE FLYING ... on 20th June'
    'we ARE STAYING at a hotel'
    'we ARE HIRING a car'
    → Present Continuous

    ⚠ LEKIN doimiy holat — Present Simple:
       'Claire and I LOVE climbing'
       'We WANT to travel'

 3-PARAGRAF — NIYATLAR (sana yo'q):
    'I AM GOING TO START exercising'
    'I AM GOING TO JOIN an art class'
    → BE GOING TO (niyat, reja)

    ⚠ 'We ARE COMING BACK ... on 21st July'
    — sana bor → Present Continuous

 4-PARAGRAF:
    'I NEARLY FORGOT!' → Past Simple
    'On 30th July I AM HAVING a party'
    → Present Continuous (sana bor)
    'You CAN SPEND the night' → can (ruxsat)

 5-PARAGRAF — YAKUN:
    'That IS all for now.'
    'HOPE TO SEE you soon.'


⚠ UNIT 13 NING ASOSIY QOIDASI:

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ANIQ VAQT/SANA
     belgilangan reja
     'We are flying ON 20TH JUNE.'

  BE GOING TO — NIYAT, sana hali yo'q
     'I am going to start exercising.'

  WILL — bashorat, va'da, o'sha zahotgi
     qaror


⚠ IShORALARNI GAPGA AYLANTIRISh QOIDALARI:

  1) Kerakli SO'ZLARNI qo'shing:
     artikllar (a, an, the), predloglar (on,
     at, to, for), egalik olmoshlari (my,
     our)

     'I/go/on holiday/with/friend/Claire'
     → 'I am going on holiday with MY friend
        Claire'

  2) FE'LNI to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.

  3) BOG'LOVChILARNI saqlang:
     'so' (shuning uchun), 'because' (chunki),
     'and' (va), 'too' (ham)

  4) BOSh HARF va TINISh belgilarini
     qo'shing.


XAT YOZISh QOIDALARI (do'stona xat):

  MANZIL — o'ng yuqorida
  SANA — manzil ostida
  MUROJAAT — 'Dear Pam,' (VERGUL bilan)
  YAKUN — 'Love,' / 'Best wishes,' (do'stona)
  IMZO — ism

  ⚠ Rasmiy xatda: 'Dear Mr Smith,' ...
    'Yours sincerely,'


DIQQAT — 'GUESS WHAT!':
  'Guess what!' = Bilasanmi nima!
  Yangilikni e'lon qilishdan oldingi ibora.


DIQQAT — 'I NEARLY FORGOT!':
  'nearly' = deyarli
  'I nearly forgot!' = Deyarli unutayozdim!

  forget → FORGOT → forgotten


DIQQAT — 'TO HIRE A CAR':
  'to hire a car' = mashina ijaraga olmoq
  (AmE: 'to rent a car')


DIQQAT — 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':
  'to lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq
  'to put on weight' = vazn olmoq

  lose → LOST → lost


DIQQAT — 'LEARN HOW TO PAINT':
  'learn HOW TO do something' = qilishni
  o'rganmoq


DIQQAT — 'TRY TO COME':
  'try TO do' = qilishga harakat qilmoq
  'try DOING' = sinab ko'rmoq (boshqa ma'no)


DIQQAT — 'SPEND THE NIGHT':
  'to spend the night' = tunab qolmoq


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Guess what!  = Bilasanmi nima!
  a whole month = butun bir oy
  the Pyrenees = Pireney tog'lari
  climbing     = tog'ga chiqish
  to hire a car = mashina ijaraga olmoq
  to travel around = bo'ylab sayohat qilmoq
  autumn       = kuz
  to exercise  = sport bilan shug'ullanmoq
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  an art class = rassomchilik to'garagi
  to paint     = rasm chizmoq
  nearly       = deyarli
  to forget    = unutmoq
  to have a party = bazm o'tkazmoq
  to spend the night = tunab qolmoq
  That's all for now = hozircha shu
  Hope to see you soon = tez orada
                 ko'rishamiz degan umiddaman

tasks.en: Use the prompts below to complete Helen's letter to her friend, Pam. (15 marks)
tasks.uz: Quyidagi ishoralardan foydalanib, Helenning dugonasi Pamga yozgan xatini to'ldiring. (15 ball)

tasks.en: Para 1:  Guess what! I am going on holiday with my friend Claire for a whole month!
tasks.uz: 1-paragraf: Bilasanmi nima! Men dugonam Kler bilan butun bir oyga ta'tilga chiqyapman!
tasks.note:
ISHORA: I/go/on holiday/with/friend/Claire/
whole month!

QO'SHILDI: am ...ing, MY, FOR A.

'AM GOING' — rejalashtirilgan kelajak
(Present Continuous).
'go ON holiday' — turg'un ibora.

tasks.en: Para 2:  We are flying to Spain on 20th June. Claire and I love climbing, so we are staying at a hotel near the Pyrenees. We want to travel around Spain too, so we are hiring a car.
tasks.uz: 2-paragraf: 20-iyunda Ispaniyaga uchamiz. Kler bilan ikkalamiz tog'ga chiqishni yaxshi ko'ramiz, shuning uchun Pireney tog'lari yaqinidagi mehmonxonada turamiz. Ispaniya bo'ylab ham sayohat qilmoqchimiz, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga olamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ IKKI XIL ZAMON BIR PARAGRAFDA:

REJA (sana bor) → Present Continuous:
  'are FLYING on 20th June'
  'are STAYING at a hotel'
  'are HIRING a car'

DOIMIY holat → Present Simple:
  'Claire and I LOVE climbing'
  'We WANT to travel'

'to hire a car' = mashina ijaraga olmoq.

tasks.en: Para 3:  We are coming back from our holidays on 21st July and I have got lots of plans for the autumn. First, I am going to start exercising because I want to lose some weight. I am going to join an art class and learn how to paint, too.
tasks.uz: 3-paragraf: 21-iyulda ta'tildan qaytamiz va kuz uchun ko'p rejalarim bor. Avvalo, sport bilan shug'ullana boshlayman, chunki biroz vazn tashlamoqchiman. Rassomchilik to'garagiga ham yoziladigan va rasm chizishni o'rganaman.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'BE GOING TO' — NIYAT (aniq sana YO'Q):
  'am GOING TO START exercising'
  'am GOING TO JOIN an art class'

Lekin 'are COMING BACK on 21st July' —
SANA bor → Present Continuous.

'to lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq.
'learn HOW TO paint' — 'how to' qurilmasi.

tasks.en: Para 4:  Oh! I nearly forgot! On 30th July I am having a party at my house. Please try to come. You can spend the night here.
tasks.uz: 4-paragraf: Voy! Deyarli unutayozdim! 30-iyulda uyimda bazm o'tkazaman. Iltimos, kelishga harakat qil. Kechasi shu yerda qolsang bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'I nearly FORGOT!' — Past Simple
(forget → FORGOT).

'On 30th July I AM HAVING a party' — sana
bor → Present Continuous.

'try TO come' (harakat qilmoq);
'try DOING' — sinab ko'rmoq (boshqa ma'no).

'CAN spend' — ruxsat berish.

tasks.en: Para 5:  Well, that is all for now. Hope to see you soon.
tasks.uz: 5-paragraf: Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Tez orada ko'rishamiz degan umiddaman.
tasks.note:
Do'stona xatning turg'un yakuni:
  'That's all for now.'
  'Hope to see you soon.'
  'Write back soon.'

Keyin: 'Love, Helen' (do'stona imzo).

tasks.en: Xat tuzilishi:  14, Scott Road / Romley / 8th June, ... — Dear Pam, — ... — Love, Helen
tasks.uz: Manzil va sana yuqorida; 'Dear Pam,' murojaat; 'Love, Helen' yakun.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Uchta shakl: Infinitive — Past Simple — Past Participle.

wordFormation.ruleUz: TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (5-mashq) — ikkala shakl BIR XIL
⚠ 10-MASHQNING ASOSIY NAMUNASI: Present Perfect → Past Simple
wordFormation.explanationUz: Avval NATIJA (vaqtsiz), keyin TAFSILOT (vaqt bilan). Bu — Unit 15 ning kaliti.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Karen has lived here since 1989. She has lived here for many years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Keren 1989-yildan beri shu yerda yashaydi. U ko'p yillardan beri shu yerda yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SINCE + boshlanish nuqtasi (1989, Monday);
FOR + davomiylik (3 years, a month).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When did you visit the museum?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'WHEN' bilan Present Perfect ISHLATILMAYDI.
'When have you visited?' — DOIM XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sharon has never travelled by plane.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IKKI INKOR MUMKIN EMAS:
'hasn't never' ✗ → 'has never' ✓
yoki 'hasn't ever' ✓

sentencePatterns.formula: IT WILL BE + [ob-havo sifati].   /   THERE WILL BE + [ot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be snowy in Montreal. There will be snow in Montreal.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Monrealda qorli bo'ladi. Monrealda qor bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ob-havo SIFATI bilan → IT;
ob-havo OTI bilan → THERE.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You mustn't smoke in hospitals. You shouldn't use aerosols.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kasalxonada chekish mumkin emas. Aerozol ishlatmaslik kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
MUSTN'T — qat'iy taqiq (qonun);
SHOULDN'T — maslahat (yaxshi emas).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mum, can I have an ice-cream, please?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ruxsat so'rash — CAN/COULD/MAY.
'Must I ...?' = 'Majburmanmi?' — boshqa ma'no.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is cooking dinner at the moment.
I have already visited Buckingham Palace. We visited it on Friday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bukingem saroyiga allaqachon borganman. Unga juma kuni bordik.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TESTNING ASOSIY NAMUNASI:
avval NATIJA (vaqtsiz → Present Perfect),
keyin TAFSILOT (vaqt bilan → Past Simple).

sentencePatterns.formula: I HAVE BEEN to [joy].   /   I HAVEN'T BEEN to [joy] YET.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have also been to Harrods. I haven't been to Covent Garden yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Harrods'ga ham borib keldim. Hali Kovent Gardenga bormadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'BEEN' = borib KELDI (hozir u yerda emas);
'GONE' = ketdi, HALI u yerda.

sentencePatterns.formula: HAS + [ega] + [V3] ... YET?  —  Yes, ... . He HAS JUST + [V3].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has Peter washed the car yet? — Yes, he has. He's just finished.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Piter mashinani yuvdimi? — Ha. U hozirgina tugatdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
YET — savol/inkor, GAP OXIRIDA;
JUST — tasdiq, HAVE va V3 ORASIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: What are you doing tonight?  —  Would you like to go?  —  That would be great!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What are you doing tonight? ... Would you like to go? — Yes, that would be great!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsan? ... Borishni xohlaysanmi? — Ha, zo'r bo'lardi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Taklif qilish dialogi.
'What are you doing tonight?' — Present
Continuous kelajak ma'nosida.

sentencePatterns.formula: You SHOULD + [fe'l].  /  CAN I + [fe'l]?  /  You MUSTN'T + [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should see a doctor. Can I have a glass of milk? You mustn't feed the animals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shifokorga ko'rin. Bir stakan sut ichsam bo'ladimi? Hayvonlarni boqma.

sentencePatterns.formula: I AM GOING TO + [fe'l]   ↔   I AM + [fe'l]ING + ON [sana].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am going to start exercising. I am having a party on 30th July.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sport bilan shug'ullana boshlayman. 30-iyulda bazm o'tkazaman.
